en.headline: Immigration Department opens new e-Channel registration station at Huanggang port
en.dek: The station on the departure level lets parents register children aged 7 to 17 on the spot for cooperative inspection e-Channels, with the director inspecting operations on Saturday.
body: The Immigration Department has set up a new e-Channel registration station on the fifth-floor departure level at the rebuilt Huanggang control point to help families complete registration for the cooperative inspection self-service channels.

The department said on Saturday that the station assists adults and children aged 7 to 17 who have not yet registered via the Hong Kong e-Channel mobile app. Parents can bring eligible children to complete the process on site, after which the whole family can use the channels. Director of Immigration Benson Kwok and Deputy Director Cheng Wo-muk inspected the facility and encouraged frontline staff.

The department said it would continue to monitor passenger and vehicle flows in real time, deploy staff flexibly and coordinate closely with the mainland side, with extra personnel on weekends to guide travellers. The new Huanggang port uses a cooperative inspection model that allows one-stop clearance.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸5樓離境層增設e-道登記站 方便家長即場為子女登記
zh.dek: 入境處今日表示，新登記站協助未用手機應用程式登記的市民及7至17歲子女，完成後可使用合作查驗e-道，處長郭俊峯到場視察。
body: 入境事務處在重建後的皇崗口岸5樓離境層增設全新e-道登記站，方便尚未透過「香港e-道」流動應用程式登記的家庭即場辦理合作查驗自助通道手續。
處方今日在社交平台表示，家長可攜同7至17歲的合資格子女到站辦理，完成登記後全家均可使用該渠道過關。入境處處長郭俊峯及副處長（管制、簽證及證件）程和木今日到場視察運作，與前線人員交流並予以肯定。
入境處表示會即時監察客流和車流，靈活調配人手，並與內地口岸保持緊密聯繫，周末期間加派人手提供指引，保障通關暢順。皇崗口岸採用合作查驗、一次放行模式。
